# WebFetchRoute

How fetched content was obtained.

**Kind:** a string enum, used in responses.

## Values

| Value | Description |
|---|---|
| `"Datacenter"` | The scraping provider on its datacenter tier. |
| `"Residential"` | The scraping provider on its residential tier. |
| `"Stealth"` | The scraping provider in stealth mode. |
| `"Direct"` | Downloaded directly by Maitento (files, which the provider does not serve). |

New values can appear, so treat one you don't know as "something else", not as an error.

## Where it's used

- Inside [`IngestedFileWebSource`](ingested-file-web-source.md)
